scope: Headless MuJoCo current model, production PD/feedback adapters, fixed simulation-time policy/control ticks; not GUI/FSM scheduling equivalence

metadata.scope: Headless MuJoCo current model, production PD/feedback adapters, fixed simulation-time policy/control ticks; not GUI/FSM scheduling equivalence
metadata.warmup: 2s fixed default stance followed by 3s zero-command PPO; independent reset for every case

definitions.cadence: Same-foot repeated landings after 5N/2N hysteresis, 10ms persistence, <20ms chatter removal; complete air runs >=30ms, periods .1..1.5s; pooled median over four feet. Not policy/control Hz.
definitions.clearance: Collision sphere bottom above flat floor, peak per complete air run; not body/link origin z.
definitions.outward_hip: Left q_hip / right -q_hip, positive=abducted outward; averaged front/rear. This is not a yaw joint angle.
definitions.foot_width: Mean left-right collision center separation in base frame.
definitions.jitter: Physical roll/pitch and angular velocity; desired yaw excluded. Acceleration finite-difference and rapid-motion proxies are not measured hardware vibration.
